novelty_search.nearest_result: A local resid10 pair-support sign gate is direction-entangled, while the typed dual graph still requires an external raw-text task selector. No direction-matched cross-task interchange has localized when the final-token state selects an answer vocabulary.
novelty_search.new_question: At which residual boundary, if any, does swapping the final-token state between direction-matched has/had and is/was prompts transfer output-pair identity?

population: Sixteen A1 pairs matched exactly by novel occupation and temporal direction across the has/had and is/was banks. Each orientation is tested; sequence lengths may differ, but the patched final semantic token is the identical occupation token.

operator.task_support: Mean soft-capped logits of the donor answer pair minus mean soft-capped logits of the recipient answer pair, independent of within-pair temporal sign.
operator.intervention: At each registered resid:00 through resid:18 boundary, replace only the recipient final-token residual vector with the direction-matched other-task donor vector.
controls: native capability for both task pairs and directions
operator.no_rescue: No layer, task-support functional, pairing, threshold, site, or orientation changes after outcomes open.

predictions.pred_a_authority_pairing_capability_and_: All hashes, 16 one-to-one direction/occupation matches, four-token native capability, identical patch-token IDs, finite coverage, and identity controls pass.
predictions.pred_b_bidirectional_task_state_transfer: At least one residual site moves task support donorward in >=0.75 of rows and reaches mean normalized donor recovery >=0.50 separately in both orientations.
predictions.pred_c_stable_onset: The earliest jointly passing site is followed by at least two consecutive jointly passing sites, preventing a one-layer numerical spike from defining onset.
predictions.pred_d_temporal_value_not_destroyed: At the selected onset, the donor task's correct temporal token beats its mate in >=0.75 of rows in both orientations.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 42 forwards/672 examples, 38 causal site-orientation arms plus 38 identity controls evaluated from the same calls, zero fit/search/backward/update.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: localize a bidirectional direction-matched task-pair state onset for deeper module decomposition.
terminal.null: Instrument passes but no stable bidirectional task-state onset meets the frozen bars; retain the external selector boundary.
terminal.invalid: Authority, pairing, capability, patch-token identity, intervention identity, coverage, finiteness, or price fails.
